description: The library window may read and write inside the app's own data directory, and nowhere else. The two appdata scope permissions bound every path the app can name to $APPDATA, so her documents, her desktop and the rest of the disk are unreachable from here. The command list is exactly what storage/fs-adapter.js and storage/migrate.js call and nothing more; fs:allow-rename is the one that matters most, because it is the commit step of every atomic write.
